About.pillar4Desc: Native bilingual architecture with Noto Sans Bengali typography and full translation key parity.
About.valuesSubtitle: Engineering standards that keep software maintainable over years, not months.
About.value1Desc: TypeScript and Pydantic end-to-end to catch bugs during development, not in production.
About.value2Desc: Vitest suites and continuous integration pipelines guaranteeing that every release is stable.
About.value3Desc: Fixed deliverables, clear version control, and zero vendor lock-in for your intellectual property.
About.teamDesc: We are a distributed team of systems architects, full-stack engineers, and machine learning practitioners passionate about software reliability.

Pricing.modelFixedDesc: Clear project boundaries, defined deliverables, and guaranteed completion milestones.

Pricing.currencyNote: All prices listed in USD. Local invoicing in BDT is supported for Bangladesh clients via official bank transfer.
Pricing.faqsSubtitle: Direct answers to questions regarding payment terms, scopes, and invoicing.
Pricing.faq1A: For fixed-scope projects, payments are typically split into milestones (e.g. 30% upfront, 40% after prototype/staging verification, and 30% upon final production handoff).
Pricing.faq2Q: Can Bangladesh clients pay in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT)?
Pricing.faq2A: Yes, we support official BDT invoicing via local corporate bank transfer, using the prevailing verified exchange rates.
Pricing.faq3Q: What happens if our project scope changes during development?
Pricing.faq3A: We maintain a transparent change-order process. Any modifications to deliverables are documented and approved by both parties before work proceeds.
Pricing.faq4Q: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
Pricing.faq4A: Yes, we offer monthly retainer packages covering 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patching, and regular feature updates.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy — Reverse Cloud
metadata.description: How Reverse Cloud collects, uses, protects and retains personal information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Reverse Cloud receives through this website and client services, why we use it, and the choices available to you.

collection.title: Information we collect and use
collection.body: We collect information you submit, including contact, account, project, payment-reference and scheduling details. Limited technical information supports sessions, security and abuse prevention. We use it to answer enquiries, provide services, arrange meetings, document payments, secure the service and meet legal duties.

sharing.title: Providers and sharing
sharing.body: We share only what is needed with providers such as Supabase for authentication and data, Google for optional sign-in, Cloudflare for security, Cal.com for scheduling, and configured notification providers. We may disclose information when law requires it or to protect the service. We do not sell personal information.

retention.title: Retention and security
retention.body: We retain records only as long as needed for service delivery, security, disputes and applicable record-keeping duties. Anonymous chat sessions are scheduled to expire after 90 days. Cal.com delivery records store identifiers and hashes rather than full attendee payloads. We use access controls, encrypted transport, signed requests and audit records.

rights.title: Your choices and contact
rights.body: You may ask to access, correct or delete your information, restrict certain processing, or withdraw consent for future use. Some records may remain where contracts, security or law require it. Send a request through the contact page. We may update this policy and will show the revision date here.

metadata.title: Terms of Service — Reverse Cloud
metadata.description: Terms for using Reverse Cloud's website, accounts and professional services.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the Reverse Cloud website, client portal, scheduling tools and professional services. A signed proposal may add project-specific terms.

use.title: Using the service
use.body: You must provide accurate information, protect account credentials and avoid unauthorized access, harmful content, impersonation, interference or unlawful use. We may limit access needed to protect users and the service.

projects.title: Proposals, work and payments
projects.body: Website estimates and preliminary discussions are informational until both parties accept a written proposal. That document controls scope, timing, acceptance, fees, taxes and payment milestones. Portal payment records document amounts acknowledged by Reverse Cloud.

rights.title: Content and third-party services
rights.body: You retain rights in material you provide and authorize its use to perform the service. Each party retains pre-existing intellectual property; deliverable rights follow the accepted proposal. Authentication, scheduling and communications may rely on third parties and their separate terms.

changes.title: Availability, termination and changes
changes.body: Website features may be interrupted or changed. To the extent allowed by law, neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss; project-specific terms take priority. Account access may be suspended for security, non-payment or material breach. Updated terms show their revision date.
